entry.title: Midiverb 0.3.0
entry.summary: Alesis Midiverb / Midifex / Midiverb II emulator (23.4 kHz DASP interpreter). Needs your own ROM dumps. Port of the Schwung module **Midiverb** by charlesvestal to the MPC/Force plugin host, compiled unchanged from `charlesvestal/schwung-midiverb` at `12077e909d93` (`GPL-3.0-only`), linked with the mpc-vst-plugins VST2 wrapper and this repository's Schwung adapter `adapters/schwungfx/`. Gen1 build: armv7, glibc ≤ 2.29. ## Sources - module: https://github.com/charlesvestal/schwung-midiverb/tree/1
